name: SF-Team-app
start: if [ -n "$SF_AUTH_URL" ]; then umask 077; f=$(mktemp); printf "%s" "$SF_AUTH_URL" > "$f"; sf org login sfdx-url --sfdx-url-file "$f" --alias euna --set-default >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "Authenticated euna org" || echo "SF_AUTH_URL set but sf login failed (continuing)"; rm -f "$f"; else echo "SF_AUTH_URL not set; skipping org auth"; fi
